en: The image shows the reverse side of a postcard. The text is printed in French and references a painting by N. Grigoresco (Nicolae Grigorescu, 1838–1907), titled 'Paysanne' (meaning 'Peasant Woman'). It mentions the painting's dimensions and medium (oil on canvas), and at the bottom, there is a publisher's note: 'Publié par les Méridiens-Editions, Bucarest — 1962', indicating it was published in Bucharest in 1962.
